To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
forages of Armenia are rich in nutrients and energy and can be used for feeding livestock.

the IVD content in the forage plants studied ranged between 524 and 618 g/kg DM, the CP content between 72 and 200, the GE content between 17.0 and 19.0 and the DE content between 9.5 and 11.2 MJ/ kg DM.

the IVD, GE and DE contents in forage plants of Armenia were comparable to those of forage plants of other regions, and the IVD content was 0.6-0.8 units lower than the IVD content in forage plants in the USA.
